Compare one library service with Victoria

Source: R/compare_visits.R
compare_visits.Rd

Compares a library service's visits per resident with the Victorian statewide rate for each financial year from 2022-23 to 2024-25. It also calculates the difference and the service's rank each year.

Usage

compare_visits(service)

Arguments

service

Name of a library service in library_visits, for example "Yarra".

Value

A data frame with one row per financial year and the columns library_service, financial_year, visits_per_person, vic_visits_per_person (statewide rate), difference (service minus Victoria), rank (1 = highest visits per resident), n_services (number of ranked services) and reported.

Details

The statewide rate is total Victorian visits divided by total population, not the average of individual service rates.

Only services that reported data are ranked. Missing years have NA for visits per resident, difference and rank.

Examples

compare_visits("Yarra")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 8
#>   library_service financial_year visits_per_person vic_visits_per_person
#>   <chr>           <chr>                      <dbl>                 <dbl>
#> 1 Yarra           2022-23                     5.74                  3.05
#> 2 Yarra           2023-24                     6.13                  3.37
#> 3 Yarra           2024-25                     6.21                  3.48
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: difference <dbl>, rank <int>, n_services <int>,
#> #   reported <lgl>

# Towong did not report in 2022-23 or 2023-24
compare_visits("Towong")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 8
#>   library_service financial_year visits_per_person vic_visits_per_person
#>   <chr>           <chr>                      <dbl>                 <dbl>
#> 1 Towong          2022-23                    NA                     3.05
#> 2 Towong          2023-24                    NA                     3.37
#> 3 Towong          2024-25                     1.91                  3.48
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: difference <dbl>, rank <int>, n_services <int>,
#> #   reported <lgl>
